metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the pointing handed over, Errors, and the run to Shrovetide.

yesterday: Tomorrow the Shrew is at two, and you are not in it. Grecian Comedy is the Rose.
The twentieth of February is the comedy's first day, as you named it. Shrove Tuesday, the fourth of March, is the stop. A comedy needs no jig, and Kemp has heard it.
Shrove Tuesday is the company's stop. You do not yet know the day you will tell Anne.
The packet is not this week's leaf.
